suggestions.assertion: Checks for existing knowledge via librarian skill before starting
suggestions.reason: This run passed by documenting an Existing Knowledge section while noting the librarian skill was unavailable — i.e. it did not actually invoke a librarian search. The assertion cannot distinguish an executed librarian check from a well-written placeholder. Consider verifying an actual librarian tool/skill invocation in the transcript, or accept the section-presence interpretation explicitly.

suggestions.assertion: Edge cases cover payment method expiration scenarios
suggestions.reason: Expiration is handled indirectly (payment-method removal/update during dunning, lost/stolen card) rather than an explicit 'card expired' edge case. The assertion passes on adjacent coverage; consider requiring an explicit expiration scenario if that is the intended discriminator.

No assertion checks internal consistency between each capability's 'Connects to' field and the Dependency Map table. This run is consistent, but a contradictory map would pass all current structural assertions — a consistency assertion would be discriminating.

eval_feedback.overall: Strong, format-conformant output; all 32 assertions pass with genuine substance. The librarian-check assertion is the weakest discriminator since the skill could satisfy it via a written placeholder when the librarian tool is absent.
